EN7-Q01: Each enemy in30ft radius behaves randomly; CoreAction/range30ft/Instantaneous.
Recommend A as a new completion, not a claim that radius fixes center placement. Define actual enemy classification without revealing hidden alignment or loyalty, LoE and whole-body intersection. Choose exact finite duration and save schedule. Preserve30ft radius and enemy-only scope.

EN7-Q02: Accepted lower Confusion has a native d4 behavior table, independent direction/target draws, one hard admission and actual regular-start opportunities.
Recommend explicit A. Show all table entries, unavailable-budget/target/no-safe-path outcomes, perception-qualified target sets and stable draw identity. No reroll-until-harmful, forced finite resources, extra turns or hidden target list. Decide coexistence with lower Confusion and other instructions by actual arbitration. Five Fate presentation entries stay unchanged; another behavior table is not automatically a disclosed sixth presentation.

EN7-Q03: Printed magical beastsCR12orlower,range120,concentration1minute. Lower Dominate Beast is actual Beast/INTsave60.
Recommend A and identify required catalog fields. PreserveCR12 ceiling and120range. If no full authoritative qualifying record exists, declare the future positive case conditional; authoring a profile is a separate explicit content decision. A transformed character does not acquire monsterCR by analogy.

EN7-Q04: Source control lacks precise commands/saves; actual lower Beast and higher Person have different repeat saves and same-source coexistence.
Recommend a complete local choice, including same-plane conscious mental order delivery and no remote senses/secret disclosure. Retain actual native ordinary attack sequence but no compelled spellcasting/finite expenditures. Bind future regular-start and owner-attached execution separately, one actual remaining budget and shared admission, no unwilling owner BA. Eligibility may be application-only only if expressly selected.

EN7-Q05: Area causes-2toINT/WIS/CHAchecksANDsaves; CoreAction120Instantaneous.
Recommend A. Choose radius/height, initial save or no-save, entry/cover-return behavior, all-creatures versus enemy-only and whether penalties apply only during active exposure. Preserve all six roll categories. An initial resistance save should resolve before an unestablished penalty unless a new rule explicitly says otherwise.

EN7-Q06: Same-named overlapping zones and roll snapshots can multiply penalties or leak hidden zones.
Recommend A as an expressly chosen source-local stacking policy. Actual INT/WIS/CHA ability checks and saves only, not attacks/DC/passive score by thematic inference; if passive check conversion is intended, author it explicitly. Choose whether a committed roll snapshots before or after a legal interrupt changes exposure. No private source diagnostics in player-facing failure output.

EN7-Q07: Extend ALL current Enchantment spells10minutes; Action120; this spell itself requires concentration1minute. Ordinary commitment ends own incompatible concentration before payload.
Recommend A. The printed all must cover every qualifying effect within the selected scope, not just one. Explicitly resolve whose spells, actual school used, caster-origin versus effect/recipient range and LoE. Other casters’ concentration is not automatically ended by this caster committing. An expired prior own spell cannot be revived as an extension target.

Costs commit before the counter window without refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Explicit remote-destination/concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect only as printed. Specific information protections apply to their actual subject and generating-source scope; hidden but unprotected facts are valid information, and missing facts are never invented. No automatic scaling or upcast.

NEW DE4-RNG-05 proposal under the owner's video-game-only directive. Authored dice are engine RNG operations, not physical tabletop objects. The actual conjured Fate Coin remains its existing physical game-world item with the same body, custody, hand, HP, duration and consumption. A roll event has an immutable original-event ID, replacement-lineage ID, actual generating entity/local event, original source, stable ordered component IDs, original modifiers/advantage state, target set and source-defined visibility grants. Finish the complete original RNG operation before any of these reroll permissions can commit; commit before its consequences. Fate Coin selects exactly one component of the complete eligible original operation and draws the same die type once; recompute its original reduction/selection with every other component unchanged. Mark Omen and Fate Reversal replace their own complete eligible d20 procedure. These distinctions survive digital implementation.

An engine's knowledge, logging, debug access, animation, a player's camera, knowledge of the seed, or prediction of a hidden outcome grants no character/player permission. The entire original die-result set must already be available to the acting player under the original event's established gameplay-information policy, and the source's actual perception, range, line-of-effect and resource predicates must independently pass. No eligible prompt, selectable event identifier or failure reason may reveal an otherwise hidden event. If the original source has no established visibility grant, these spells grant none; a source-specific presentation decision must be authored separately. A visible summed total alone does not reveal otherwise hidden component faces or grant a one-component choice. A fixed or automatic result with no actual RNG operation supplies no reroll event. Source-defined finite uniform 1dN random draws are eligible for Fate Coin only when their original result set is already available and the other source predicates pass; an empty set creates no draw, and the previously snapshotted candidate set never changes on replacement. Arbitrary simulation RNG, generation seeds and unexposed loot/world generation are not made eligible merely by existing in engine memory. No additional replacement RNG is consumed for a rejected preflight or a paid-but-blocked alteration; record the committed cost and guard separately from whether a new draw occurred.

Serialize legal commitments through the actual gameplay event queue. Simultaneous candidates use current initiative order; ties use stable preexisting actor ID then stable source/application ID. Outside initiative use those stable actor/source IDs fixed before this original event was generated. Network arrival, frame rate, client/UI order, reopening a prompt and a new replacement ID cannot change priority or create a new original lineage. A rejected later candidate spends no Reaction, token or permission. This is a scoped deterministic tie-break for these three spell permissions, not a rewrite of all interrupt priority or any class-specific reroll. Snapshot the original modifiers, including any eligible Alignment Nexus benefit, when the original roll is created; replacement retains those modifiers even if later alignment/ward changes would alter a genuinely new event. Apply only the final original event's consequences once. No additional cast, attack, target rescan, payment, hit, Wound, death event or resource grant is generated by a replacement.

NEW DE4-PRESENTATION-06 — proposed narrow digital presentation policy for this conference; NOT an already accepted visibility grant. This policy grants only the following event-result presentations. It does not disclose hidden creatures, secret events, source/rank/DC/AC information, hidden modifier reasons, RNG seeds or future draws. An explicit source prohibition on disclosure takes precedence. Unlisted or unclassified events remain unavailable to these three Fate permissions until separately authored; absence of a secrecy tag is not a grant.

1. OVERT-ATTACK: for an actual ordinary Core attack whose generating creature, declared attack and target are already perceived/identified by the reacting creature through its real senses, give that creature's authorized controller the complete resolved original attack d20 set before hit/miss consequences. This is an explicit new result-presentation decision, not a new sensing ability. Display the faces and which original selection rule is being applied, not the hidden causes of advantage, the target's AC or hidden modifiers. A hidden attacker or an unperceived/unknown target does not qualify under this entry. An extra camera, spectator role, battle log or engine access is not perception. An AI controller receives only the corresponding authorized view, not the entire engine state.

2. OWN-REQUESTED-CHECK: an actually requested, nonsecret ordinary ability/skill/tool check presents its complete original d20 set privately to that actor's authorized controller. Automatic/secret sensing checks, protected inquiries and hidden contests are excluded. Another reacting character can use that player's legitimate display only when that reacting character independently satisfies its own actual source perception/range/LoE and resource predicates; this rule grants no character-to-character telepathy. In a multi-character player party, the player may control both actors; a multiplayer peer does not inherit another player's private grant.

3. BURNING-HANDS-DAMAGE: once an actual reviewed Burning Hands cone is manifested and the shared 3d6 operation is generated, present the complete shared faces before damage consequences to the caster's controller and to controllers of reacting characters who actually perceive the caster and the manifested cone. This whitelist entry is specifically for the reviewed Burning Hands damage operation, not every damage pool. It reveals no target list, save result, resistance or hidden recipient. Per-recipient damage is still computed once from the one final shared total. A reaction holder must additionally pass its own actual Coin range/LoE/hand/custody predicates. A source-suppressed operation that creates no actual damage draw gives nothing to reroll.

4. CONFUSION-BEHAVIOR: for this pending Confusion procedure, show the actual finite d4 behavior, any genuinely generated d8 direction, and any genuinely generated uniform 1dN perceived-target selection privately to the affected body's authorized controller before that behavior executes. Do not expose candidates that this body cannot actually perceive. Other controllers receive no raw selection results under this entry. A player who also controls a reacting holder can use that legitimate result view only if the reacting holder independently perceives the true roll-generating body and passes Coin's other source requirements. The snapshotted set and candidate order are immutable; an empty set makes no draw. A private NPC-controller view is not disclosed to human players.

5. RESONANCE-WELL-RESERVE: show the actual initial 1d4 reserve-creation draw privately to the Well creator's authorized controller before the reserve is established. This preserves the existing timing boundary but authors its digital display; it does not expose any already-established or hidden reserve and does not permit a later reroll/refill. The reacting holder still needs Coin's real event perception/range/LoE/custody/Reaction.

For these entries only, record policyId, entryId, original event ID, the authorized controller set and the actual perception evidence at generation. Recheck the reacting source's own spatial/resource predicates at commitment. Already lawfully learned original faces are not erased by a later effect, but event knowledge alone never satisfies a currently missing character predicate. Present only information this whitelist actually grants, whether or not any observer possesses a Fate source; resource possession cannot become a detector. Total-only or hidden-result policies remain insufficient. Preserve the original RNG component IDs and reduction rule through replacement. No rejected declaration or paid-but-blocked alteration generates a replacement draw.

This is a minimum concrete policy, not a universal dice-visibility policy. In particular, unlisted enemy saving throws, trauma, secret checks, loot/world generation and private source operations remain unavailable. Future presentation entries require explicit source-specific authorship and separate review. Composition vectors that declare a visibility grant remain composition vectors; that declaration is not evidence that an unlisted live source supplies one.

NEW BURNING-HANDS EVENT-EXISTENCE COMPLETION FOR CONCURRENCE: For this source only, each actually manifested Burning Hands cone generates exactly one complete original shared3d6 operation at its ordinary damage-resolution checkpoint whether the eligible recipient set is empty, entirely hidden, or includes known recipients. It is the same cast operation, not an extra roll, attack or damage packet per recipient. A cast interrupted or prevented before manifestation generates none. A manifested empty cone deals no damage and triggers no hit/damage/Wound/kill/resource consequence, even though its finite original pool is available under BURNING-HANDS-DAMAGE. Thus the presence, number, values, availability and timing of the published pool do not encode whether hidden recipients exist. No target list, saves, defenses or damage outcome is added to this presentation. A paid Coin may alter that original empty-cone pool only through its ordinary actual predicates, with its normal consumed item/Reaction/guard and no refunded cost; it creates no recipient or successful damage event. This is explicit NEW per-source RNG-generation authorship, not a rule for other empty areas or unlisted spells.

== fate-reversal ==
Action; V/S/F. NEW: establish one personal pending permission for one minute without concentration; a successful recast replaces your prior unused permission. Core’s 60-foot range applies to the later roll’s actual generating creature/object or local event, which you must perceive with line of effect. The battlefield phrase grants no unlimited reach. After the complete initial attack, save or check d20 result is available under ordinary information rules, but before its consequences, spend your Reaction and this permission to replace the entire d20 procedure using its original modifiers and advantage/disadvantage state. A two-d20 procedure receives two new dice and normal higher/lower selection; a single-d20 procedure receives one. Use the new result even if worse. Process natural results only from the final roll under its actual attack/task/save rules. No damage, healing or resource die is covered. NEW: this joins Mark Omen and Fate Coin’s shared one-reroll guard for one original roll event and its entire replacement lineage, across all casters and recasts. Reserve that guard at legal commitment; competing declarations use initiative order or the preexisting stable actor/source order under DE4-RNG-05. An already barred declaration spends neither permission nor Reaction. Exact class rerolls retain their own timing but never reset this three-spell guard. Suppression blocks use while the original timer continues. Replaced dice generate no duplicate cast, payment, hit hook or completed consequence; interruption after commitment refunds nothing. No secret roll is revealed and no finished consequence is reversed.

CURRENT SHARED-RULE AMENDMENT: This procedure is conditional on explicit joint approval of DE4-GUARD-01 and the complete nine-file amendment draft. The previously accepted two-spell guard is not silently changed by this local proposal. ==== 13 Body placement and involuntary endings ====
## Placement and involuntary endings

A transformation does not grant movement. A voluntary size change keeps the same spatial anchor and must fit before payment. Preserve the existing footprint on a same-size change when possible.

A mandatory ending still occurs if the root anatomy does not fit. First try its normal space at the same position, then a legal squeeze under the [movement rules](COMBAT_ACTION_PLAYTEST.md). If neither fits, record a placement conflict. The **new provisional placement procedure** permits only a nearest legal adjacent placement in the same unobstructed region. It cannot pass through a wall, closed barrier or occupied space. Choose the minimum displacement that fits the whole body; among ties, preserve the greatest overlap with its previous footprint. If still tied, the Director uses a fixed neutral board order, not a tactical choice by the affected player. If no adjacent candidate fits, the conflict remains until the obstruction is removed or a legal relocation effect resolves it. Do not search farther afield.

This mandatory normalization spends no movement and triggers no opportunity attack, charge distance, movement benefit or other movement rider. It changes no remaining movement allowance and grants no invented crushing damage. It does not permit a voluntary form change to bypass its preflight.

Track actual height and terrain. Losing flight while unsupported starts ordinary falling from the current location; reversion never moves the creature directly to the ground. Ending a burrowing form underground does not move the creature to the surface. Master of Vermin's permission to pass through Tiny gaps changes clearance, not its printed size.

Use the actual space of the expressed anatomy:

| Size | Space | On a grid of 2.5-foot subcells |
|---|---|---|
| Tiny | 2.5 by 2.5 feet | 1 subcell |
| Small | 5 by 5 feet | 2 by 2 subcells |
| Medium | 5 by 5 feet | 2 by 2 subcells |
| Large | 10 by 10 feet | 4 by 4 subcells |

V6 explicitly supplies Tiny and Medium space. Small and Large complete this bounded table provisionally; the supplied V6 passage does not separately list them. Size category still matters even when two sizes occupy the same space. Squeezing changes clearance and its penalties; it does not change size, carrying capacity or weight. Exact Tiny occupancy requires subcells or equivalent measurement, not treating Tiny as Medium.



==== 19 Stunned ====
## Stunned

**Preserved Core text:** Incapacitated, cannot move, fails Strength/Dexterity saves, attacks against have advantage.

**Effect:** The creature is Incapacitated, cannot move, automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws, attack rolls against it have advantage, and it can speak only falteringly.

**Application:** Only an effect explicitly inflicting Stunned applies it; source-character hard-denial limits remain separate application rules.

**Duration and ending:** Use the applying effect's duration/repeat-save procedure.

**Stacking:** Does not stack.

**Immunities and specific exceptions:** Stun immunity blocks application. Incapacitated consequences apply, including no Bonus Action/Reaction and concentration ending under the shared rule.

**Compatible V6/source details:**

- V6 adds that the creature can speak only falteringly.

Provenance: Core V2 `books/player/Decennium_Descent_Core_Systems_Bible_v2_Known_Descent.docx`, zero-based all-XML heading paragraph 773, definition paragraph 774; both positions, exact text and book SHA-256 are verified against the approved book and retained in the [condition data](../../data/playtest/condition_playtests.json).

==== 83 newCompanionBinding ====
NEW for an actually eligible Humanoid under Dominate Person, or any eligible Confusion target, using an owner-attached companion chassis: use the actual original-owner regular attached phase, original profile and structural command/offense caps. No independent turn, dominator companion allowance or unwilling owner Bonus Action is created. A pending command reservation can be redirected only for this same companion in this same phase, under the reviewed Dominate Beast bridge; spent or another companion’s reservation cannot be stolen. A repeat WIS save occurs at the end of that real regular attached phase even when no instruction executed; this source-specific checkpoint adds no ordinary START/END, recharge or other condition tick. If no such phase is currently supplied, only an END-only six-second save schedule continues, with no orders/actions. On transitioning to actual phases, map the next unresolved save to the next regular phase end, preserve resolved saves and the original maximum, and never replay an opportunity. This extension is proposed explicitly; it is not already conferred by Dominate Beast.

==== 84 newEndSaveBinding ====
NEW: Overwhelming Grief, Charm Monster, Erase Emotion and Phantasmal Killer use affected regular-END saves, including an affected current turn, without extra-turn saves. Outside initiative their first END-only save is at application +6 seconds and then each six seconds. On entering initiative map the next unresolved save to the next actual regular END, retain completed saves and the original absolute maximum, and do not add an immediate transition save. For an owner-attached target, use its actual regular attached-phase end with the same END-only fallback/transition above, granting no actions. Dominate Person and Confusion instead use their shared behavior cycle and companion binding.

==== 85 newCompanionPulseBinding ====
NEW for Illusion Phantasmal Killer on an owner-attached companion: its periodic packet uses the beginning of the actual original-owner regular attached phase, after that phase’s required processing, under the same once-per-numbered-round exposure. It creates no independent START or other start-trigger event. If no actual phase exists, use only the six-second damage schedule and original deadline, granting no actions. Transition to a real phase maps the next unresolved pulse opportunity without replaying an initial or completed pulse. Its separately scheduled repeat save still follows the END-only bridge.

==== 110 digitalGeometry ====
NEW scoped geometry for these25 cards: use actual world-space 3D occupied body volumes and Euclidean feet, not display sprites or the historical grid diagonal metric. Single-target range is the nearest actual caster-to-target body distance. A chosen area center must be a perceived point within the stated range from the actual caster body, with originating line of effect. A creature qualifies only if at least one actual body point intersects the closed specified volume and has line of effect from the relevant area origin/center. Tangency counts as intersection. Total cover prevents that application. Fix the whole recipient set and geometry after cast interruptions and before damage; destroying cover gives no second scan. Friendly targets and the caster are included whenever an ALL-creature shape actually includes them; ENEMIES means creatures the caster already ordinarily identifies as enemies at this snapshot, with no hidden-hostility or faction scan. No spell title creates an object-targeting permission. The earlier source-required individual perception predicate for enemy-only selection is retained; awareness without the required actual perception does not silently add a target. A card's own explicit origin exclusion, object mode, prism/cone shape or actual typed predicate takes precedence.

==== 111 lineAndCone ====
NEW scoped digital presentation of each actual proposed shape, not a global template: Meteor Spear retains its60x5x5 rectangular prism; Sunbeam retains60ft length/5ft-diameter cylinder; Supernova Lance proposes100ft length/5ft-diameter cylinder. Cone of Cold retains60ft axial length with full diameter d at axial distance d, so radius=d/2 and far diameter60. Use exact continuous Euclidean body intersection, not a tabletop raster convention. Horrid Wilting proposes an oriented30ft cube with chosen center in30ft range. Cast-specific origins and line-of-effect remain actual. None changes the geometry of an accepted other spell.

NEW DC25-SHAPE-POSE-01, limited to these proposed cards: store the actual shape origin/center and its complete orientation at the legal geometry-selection checkpoint (normal commitment, or target selection at a legal Ready release). For Meteor Spear record a unit forward axis and two mutually perpendicular unit cross-section axes forming an orthonormal frame; points are origin+s*forward+u*right+v*up, 0<=s<=60 and |u|,|v|<=2.5. This removes undefined roll about a vertical/oblique spear axis. For Horrid Wilting record three orthonormal cube axes; each signed coordinate relative to the perceived chosen center lies in[-15,15]. No rounding of a sphere or cone to occupied grid tiles is permitted. Cylinders and the circular cone are rotationally symmetric about their stored axes; do not add an arbitrary prism height to them. Closed-body tangency counts except the card's explicit origin-only caster contact exclusion. Range/line-of-effect/field-origin predicates continue to use their actual source, not a rendering transform. Geometry choices are declared before results and never selected to fit a later save, hidden-defense result or damage outcome. This does not change another accepted spell or the global movement geometry.

==== 112 saveAndDamage ====
A specified save uses8+PB+the real casting modifier under the actual placement/class and actual modifiers. Save outcomes are binary, not degrees; save damage never criticals. For each card use exactly its success branch, not a universal half-damage default. Unless a card expressly says per-target, use one shared raw pool for its area/chain and separate recipient damage packets, roots and actual defenses. Elemental Devastation explicitly rolls separately per enemy. Mixed typed parts of one actual hit stay one damage event for Wound/zero/lifecycle consequences; Meteor Spear alone uses its explicitly NEW DC25-MIXED-DEFENSE-02 apportionment at the one actually authorized source stage; this is not a general mixed-damage engine. Halve each specified raw typed part with floor only when that card says half, before applicable defenses. Apply ordinary real damage, temporary HP, Wounds, zero/death/Stable/Dying and source-specific callbacks once. No creature type supplies an unprinted blanket mental or damage immunity.

==== 113 rootsAndSuppression ====
At the actual permitted damage application create each recipient root under the accepted creation-time dealer/Null rules, even when the RNG pool is shared. Caster is the dealer for these direct spells; an arc origin is not a new dealer. Separate recipients and genuinely separate casts keep distinct roots. Apply current Lesser Antimagic, Globe and genuine defenses to actual payload locus/origin/rank. Globe blocks only its covered incoming rank0–5 application; rank6+ is outside that ceiling. An initially prevented rider does not establish or wait for later suppression ending. Established condition records retain identity, clocks and spent history through suppression; expired/ended records never replay. Completed instantaneous damage is not dispellable after the fact. No attack, roll, concentration, resource or root is manufactured by presentation or reentry.

==== 114 control ====
Stunned and Paralyzed attempt independent hard-denial components under the accepted one-source-character/target/encounter guard; a prior spent guard prevents only that new hard component with no unprinted fallback. A failed save can still resolve independent damage. Damage-type immunity does not prevent a separately legal condition, and condition immunity does not prevent damage. Establishment spends the hard guard once; no later recast, source rename, suppression or expiration refunds it. Prone, Blinded, Frightened and the explicit limited Reaction/movement losses use their actual narrower scope; they do not acquire hard-denial immunity by association.

==== 115 duration ====
Use each complete spell-specific endpoint, including its named regular-turn or actual attached-phase bridge. A generic default does not replace those original authored records. Preserve original typed/absolute clocks through reorder/absence/extra turns; initial prevention creates no deferred component. Any new companion/no-schedule bridge remains explicitly proposed and requires review. For the seven newly authored high-rank cards with no earlier record, the current01 one-target-round fallback is retained only where actually specified: original next future regular END or6sec outside/no independent schedule, without inventing creature turns. ==== 145 P20-CLOCKS-01 ====

==== 146 P20-ATTACHED-PHASE-01 ====

==== 147 P20-FAMILY-EXPOSURE-01 ====
NEW per-source anti-duplication applies only where the individual procedure names a family cap: record target identity, named spell family, explicit category and numbered round.  Falling 
 ## Falling bridge — new provisional procedure

This is a newly authored table procedure agreed with the GPT notebook, **not recovered V6/Core V2 canon**. Focused searches of the current rulebook extract, Core V2 and mechanics/manual text found spell summaries but no operational falling clock or impact formula. Before promotion to canon, inspect the approved V6 environment/travel/hazard sections and archived environment tables. Preserve any older rule found and compare it explicitly.

When a creature loses support with no movement mode or effect keeping it aloft, it enters **Falling** immediately. Falling means unsupported; it grants no hovering, airborne walking or lateral movement. Track total distance descended during this fall and cumulative distance during its current uncontrolled portion, both initially zero.

**Timing:** If a fall begins during a regular initiative turn, set a fixed Fall Marker at the **end of that initiative slot in the following round**. Resolve the first Falling Step there, then one at the same marker each round. Reactions and extra turns use the enclosing regular initiative slot; an event between slots uses the most recently completed slot. Extra turns, extra Actions and initiative changes neither move nor multiply the marker. This gives every participant one normal turn opportunity before the first descent; inability to act still matters and no free rescue action is granted. A caster still needs legal targets within range when spending their Action.

Outside initiative, when timing matters, establish an order before descent and use a virtual slot immediately before its first regular slot as the initiating slot. The first step occurs when that virtual slot next recurs, after everyone has had one normal turn opportunity. When no rescue or other timing decision is possible, the Director can resolve the same descent and impact calculation directly. This is an explicit timing abstraction, not a model of physical acceleration.

If a fall begins after initiative has been established but before any regular initiative slot has yet completed, treat the virtual pre-round slot as the most recently completed slot for Fall Marker purposes.

**Ordinary descent:** At each step descend up to **300 feet**, stopping on a supporting surface. Add the distance to both trackers. On landing while uncontrolled, take **min(10, floor(uncontrolled distance / 20))d6 bludgeoning damage**. The uncontrolled distance includes earlier steps; never use only the final step's remainder.

**Feather Fall:** The spell retains its **Action** casting time and reduces descent to at most **60 feet per step**. When it takes effect, set uncontrolled distance to zero: the magic dissipates prior uncontrolled momentum in this abstraction. Keep total fall distance. If landing while it remains active, damage is **min(3, floor(total fall distance / 20))d6 bludgeoning**. This explicitly limits impact exposure without guaranteeing a harmless landing. When the spell ends aloft, reset uncontrolled distance to zero, then accumulate ordinary descent from that point at the existing marker; expiry grants no immediate extra step. Its one-minute maximum ends immediately before the caster's regular turn ten rounds after casting. If expiry and a step coincide, resolve expiry first. Earlier landing or cessation of Falling ends the spell on that target as printed.

Apply damage defenses only when their actual wording covers that damage. After damage, Falling ends; a creature suffering any positive falling damage lands **Prone** unless an explicit feature prevents it. Less than 20 relevant feet produces zero damage. Forced movement that removes support starts a fall but adds no separate fall damage. Regaining genuine support, secure support from a hold, or flight ends Falling without resolving an uncompleted impact; teleporting safely onto support likewise ends it. A later loss of support begins a new fall with new trackers and marker. Completed impact and damage cannot be undone by later casting.

| Scenario | Steps to land | Impact |
|---|---:|---:|
| Ordinary 10 feet | 1 | 0 |
| Ordinary 20 feet | 1 | 1d6 |
| Ordinary 300 feet | 1 | 10d6 |
| Ordinary 310 feet | 2 | 10d6 |
| Ordinary 610 feet | 3 | 10d6 |
| Feather Fall active through a 310-foot fall | 6 | 3d6 |
| 120 feet slowed, spell ends aloft, then 190 feet uncontrolled | 3 | 9d6 |

The 300-foot ordinary step, impact formulas, momentum reset, marker and duration conventions are provisional inventions. The source supplies Feather Fall's Action, five targets and 60-foot slowed descent. Wider hazards, equipment catches, flight loss and environmental damage still need the combat/campaign pass.



 Time and event ordering 
 ## Time and event ordering — NEW

For a duration created in initiative, record the relevant original regular start/end marker. Existing effects keep that **virtual marker**, repeating every six seconds if the creature leaves or changes initiative. Reordering, rerolling, extra turns, death/removal or leaving/reentering initiative never restart an existing duration. New effects use the current schedule. Source death still ends concentration, a source-dependent aura/tether or an effect explicitly ending on death.

- A bare hostile target-bound **N rounds** ends at the Nth future regular target-end marker. An in-progress target turn's current end does not count.
- A bare self/source buff, ally-targeted buff or source-controlled aura **N rounds** ends at the Nth future source-start marker. Explicit target-turn, pulse or absolute timing overrides this default. Activation during source turn 1 for three rounds ends at source turn 4's start.
- **Next turn** means the next future regular turn of the named creature, not the current turn's still-upcoming end. An unqualified next turn refers to source/user under the existing shared rule. Explicit “this turn” can include the current turn.
- An outside-initiative bare N-round effect instead gets an absolute application-time + N×6 seconds deadline. Entering initiative preserves that deadline.
- Explicit periodic profiles retain their registered clocks and tick counts. Never create a second timer merely because a generic duration rule also exists.

The [exact GPT review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_COMBAT_EXACT_FINDINGS.md) confirms ally-buff source clocks and excluding the current turn for explicit next-turn endpoints. The helper excludes a specific current-end marker only if that marker would otherwise be selected: application during a turn at time1 with end3 excludes3 and selects9; application at/after3 also selects9, without erroneously skipping again to15.

At a regular turn's **start**, resolve in this order:

1. Expire start-ending effects and apply immediate state changes from those expirations.
2. Refresh Reaction; tick regular-start recharge/non-action clocks.
3. Resolve already-due absolute state recovery if now legal, including a previously blocked Stable recovery deadline.
4. If still alive, dying and at 0 HP with death saves, make that turn's death save.
5. Resolve other start effects and periodic events in application order.
6. Begin voluntary turn decisions.

At **end**, resolve triggered effects, due damage, saves and maintenance before end-ending effects expire; then the slot finishes. No extra turn creates another regular marker. The caller must not reuse a resolved marker.

For simultaneous effects, earlier application timestamp precedes later. For simultaneous components of one source, its printed internal order controls; otherwise use stable application sequence, with source/mechanical ID as a final tie-break. Record that sequence when creating the effects. Beneficial/harmful labels do not change priority. Periodic family arbitration happens once per family/marker before its damage, retaining the family registry's consumed loser ticks.

Examples: dying at 0 rolls its death save before ordinary start-turn healing; a fatal death save is not undone by ordinary healing. Stable at 0 skips the save, then start-turn damage can break Stable. A natural 20 can restore 1 HP before a due Bleed drops it to 0 as a new drop event. If Decay expires while a Stable recovery deadline is already due, the old deadline resolves once without rerolling recovery time.



 Damage event and Wounds 
 ## Resolve a damage event

Resolve each genuinely separate hit or damage event once. Do not split one packet to multiply Wound saves or combine separate hits merely to cross a threshold. Feature-specific prevention that acts before damage or before reaching zero resolves at its printed timing first.

1. Resolve attack/save, damage and applicable defenses. The remaining nonnegative amount is **resolved damage**.
2. Record HP, Wounds and zero-HP state before the event. Remove temporary HP first. **Post-temp damage = resolved damage minus temporary HP absorbed.** Keep this amount even when it exceeds current HP; floor the resulting current HP at zero.
3. Check V6 Instant Death. If post-temp damage minus HP before the hit is at least maximum HP, the creature dies. For a creature already at zero, this is post-temp damage at least maximum HP. Stop: there is no Wound save, death-save failure or successful knockout from that event.
4. Otherwise, a living creature makes one Wound save if it dropped from positive HP to zero, if **2 × post-temp damage is at least maximum HP**, or if the effect actually inflicts Maiming. Overlapping triggers still cause only one save. The post-temp threshold and one-save rule are new provisional interpretations. Maiming is an independent trigger even when temporary HP absorbs all ordinary damage; immunity to Maiming itself still applies.
5. Make a Constitution save against **max(10, floor(post-temp damage / 2))**. Use pre-event Wounds for the -1-per-Wound penalty. Maiming with zero post-temp damage uses DC 10. A Wound gained now cannot penalize the roll that created it.
6. A success adds no Wound. A failure that began with zero, one or two Wounds adds exactly one; failure by 5 or more also gives that Wound one Injury. A failure that began with three Wounds kills the creature instead: no fourth Wound and no Injury roll. Stop processing later living-target consequences if dead.
7. If the creature was already at zero before this event and post-temp damage is positive, end Stable. A creature using death saves adds one failure, or two for a critical hit; three failures kill it. An ordinary creature that does not use death saves dies instead, without starting death counters. A hit from positive HP to zero does not also cause a same-packet death failure.
8. If this event newly reduces positive HP to zero, a valid melee knockout makes the surviving creature Stable. Otherwise a character/significant NPC using death saves begins dying; an ordinary monster dies. A previously Stable creature whose temporary HP absorbed all damage remains Stable unless an independent Maiming result killed it. The Director identifies significant NPCs consistently. Knockout cannot override Instant Death or a fatal Wound save.

Core's Maiming and Wound trigger rules remain subject to an actual feature's eligibility. The reference helper receives already legal events; it does not grant every attack Maiming or a damage-prevention exception.



 Zero HP and recovery 
 ## Zero HP and recovery

A living character at zero HP is Unconscious. Core's condition already includes Incapacitated, unawareness, dropping held items and falling Prone; an adjacent hit is critical as specified there. Healing does not silently remove other independent causes of Unconscious or Prone.

While dying, make one death save at the **start of each regular initiative turn**. Roll d20 without modifiers unless a feature specifically modifies death saves. Natural 20 restores 1 HP; natural 1 adds two failures. Other results of 10 or more add one success; 9 or less add one failure. Three successes make the creature Stable; three failures make it Dead. Extra turns and Actions add no extra death saves. Stable or Dead creatures do not roll them.

Regaining positive HP or becoming Stable resets both counters. Temporary HP does not raise normal HP, end Unconscious or reset counters. Fully absorbed damage does not end Stable or add a death failure in this provisional interpretation. Independent Maiming can still cause its Wound save.

**Stabilize:** an Action and DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check, or an Action using one healer's-kit use automatically, stabilizes a living dying creature at zero. It remains Unconscious and makes no death saves. Roll 1d4 once when it becomes Stable and record its absolute recovery time that many hours later. If still Stable then, it regains 1 HP. Damage reaching normal HP cancels that deadline and resumes dying with the appropriate failures. Rest and Stable recovery use the same elapsed clock, so four hours of recovery inside an eight-hour Watch do not cost twelve hours. A later rest does not separately replay the Stable healing event.

**Dead:** ordinary healing and stabilization do not restore life. Resurrection must satisfy its own willing-soul, body, time, cost and target rules. It does not automatically remove Wounds, Corruption, debts, legal death or claims upon the body. Corpses cannot supply repeated resource triggers.



 Attack/save/task procedures 
 ## Rolls

Choose the roll type before rolling. Use the actual ability modifier, including negative values, and normal proficiency only when applicable. Existing advantage/disadvantage chooses the higher/lower of two d20s; multiple sources do not stack, and any advantage plus disadvantage cancels. Add other legal modifiers once. Fractions round down unless a rule specifies otherwise. One tile is 5 feet. Class L, S and effect M retain their definitions in the shared class rules.

**Attack:** roll d20 plus the appropriate attack modifier against AC. Meeting AC hits. Natural 1 always misses; natural 20 always hits and critically doubles damage dice, not flat modifiers. Beating AC by 10 is not a critical hit. An explicit broader critical range does not stack with another; use the broadest eligible range. In this overlay, a natural result below 20 in that range must still meet AC unless the feature expressly says it always hits.

**Task, skill or tool check against a fixed DC:** total at least DC+10 is Critical Success; at least DC is Success; at most DC-10 is Critical Failure; other totals below DC are Failure. Natural 20 then improves one degree and natural 1 worsens one, bounded at either end. A task printing only success/failure collapses the two upper degrees to success and two lower degrees to failure; no extra consequence is invented. A natural 20 can still fail an otherwise impossible check, and a natural 1 with sufficient modifiers can still succeed.

**Saving throw:** total at least DC succeeds; otherwise it fails. Natural 1 and 20 have no generic special outcome. A printed failure by 5 or 10 compares the final total with the DC; it does not add an unprinted critical-save system. Death saves are the specific exception below.

**Opposed check, new provisional tie rule:** compare final totals. Higher wins; an exact tie leaves the existing state unchanged, so the initiating creature fails to change it. Do not turn task natural shifts into hidden numeric modifiers. A maneuver explicitly printing degree outcomes must specify how those apply.



 Concentration and control 
 ## Targets, concentration and control

Unless expressly stated, perceive the target, remain within range and have line of effect; total cover blocks targeting. “Ally” includes self unless it says OTHER. A list cannot contain a creature twice. Select up to the printed limit; an empty target list is not a valid way to farm activation benefits. Zones remain at their chosen point unless described as an aura; allies can leave and lose their benefits. An aura requires its owner conscious unless the card supplies a bounded exception. An effect ending at “end next turn” means the affected creature's next turn only when the card says target's; otherwise the user's.

One concentration slot for all spells, Chants, Veinweaves, forms or zones that require concentration. Starting another ends the old before the new effect resolves, except for an explicit limited linked-effect rule. Damage prompts CON save against max(10, floor(damage/2)); incapacitation or a failed save ends concentration. The round-down convention is a deliberate pilot interpretation. Concentration does not demand a Bonus Action unless maintenance says so. For a paid 3-pulse effect, start is pulse 1; pay maintenance on each of the next 2 regular turns by turn end for pulses 2/3. Missing payment ends it at that turn's end; otherwise it ends at start of turn 4. No repeated start triggers on maintenance.

Forced movement does not provoke opportunity attacks unless explicitly stated, cannot place a creature inside solid matter, and stops at an obstacle. Grapples use the card's save/DC, can be escaped with an Action and STR(Athletics) or DEX(Acrobatics) against that DC, and end beyond reach. A root sets Speed 0 but does not remove Actions. Slows reduce Speed to minimum 0. Silence blocks verbal spells/audible abilities, not all thought or all class features. Charmed effects never determine a player's beliefs; use only the printed action restrictions.

No repeated hard denial without a new save and cost. For this class suite, a creature can suffer **Stunned, compelled loss of its whole Action/turn, or equivalent hard denial from a given character at most once per encounter**, across that character's class features; later such riders fail while damage and soft riders resolve normally. Record source and target. This draft guard is broader than the older Oracle-only ceiling and is an explicit balance proposal. Reaction denial, Speed reduction, penalties and Frightened do not count as whole-turn loss. Do not silently waive boss immunities, legendary defenses or anatomy.

SPELLBOOK. At Wizard 1 your spellbook contains six chosen rank-1 Wizard spells. Arcane School Specialization also adds one legal rank-1 bonus spell of your chosen school without replacing one of those six. For this provisional progression, add 2 legal Wizard spells to the book at each Wizard level 2-4, 3 at each level 5-8, 4 at each level 9-12, 5 at each level 13-16 and 6 at each level 17-20. Level-up additions cost no money or scribing time.
PREPARED SPELL MATRIX. After a long rest, prepare a number of matrices equal to Wizard level + Intelligence modifier, minimum 1, selecting only spells currently recorded in your spellbook and within your legal rank. You cast ordinary Wizard spells only from prepared matrices unless a feature explicitly overrides that restriction. Preparing the full daily matrix set normally requires 1 hour of spellbook study. Matrix Efficiency reduces this to 45 minutes.
MIDDAY SUBSTITUTION. Once between long rests, you may perform a 10-minute Spellbook Study ritual to replace one prepared matrix with another legal spell from your spellbook. The replacement cannot exceed your legal Wizard rank. Sigil Rewrite and Matrix Mastery may improve this process as explicitly stated.
SPELL ACQUISITION BY SCRIBING. A found Wizard spell may be copied into the spellbook if its rank is legal for you. Baseline scribing requires 2 hours and 50 gp of inks/materials per spell rank, treating rank 0 as 1 for this calculation. Spell Scribing halves both values to 1 hour and 25 gp per rank. Failure to finish the work consumes no spellbook entry but materials already expended during an interrupted hour are lost.
SPELLBOOK LOSS. Losing the spellbook does not erase matrices currently prepared in memory; you may continue casting those prepared matrices until you next rebuild or change preparation. A blank replacement book can be seeded with your currently prepared spells at 1 hour and 25 gp per effective spell rank each. An unprepared spell you previously recorded can be reconstructed from memory with 8 hours, 100 gp per rank and an Intelligence (Arcana) check against DC 10 + spell rank. Failure consumes that attempt's time and half its materials; another attempt can be made after a long rest. Recovering the original book automatically restores access to its surviving entries.
ARCANE SCHOOL SPECIALIZATION is automatic at Wizard 1. Choose exactly one of the eight schools. Your spell attacks with that school gain +1 and your Wizard save DC for that school's spells gains +1. You also add one legal rank-1 spell of that school to the spellbook. The source table explicitly supplies seven school passives; the eighth core school, Abjuration, is named elsewhere but its passive row is missing. Its provisional playtest passive is identified below rather than silently presented as recovered text.
ABJURATION, provisional completion for the omitted eighth row: once per round after you cast an Abjuration spell, gain temporary HP equal to PB until the start of your next regular turn. CONJURATION: creatures summoned by your Wizard spells gain +1 maximum HP per Wizard level. DIVINATION: once per long rest reroll one failed saving throw and use the new result. ENCHANTMENT: when a creature fails its initial save against one of your Enchantment spells, a printed control duration of at least 1 round may last one additional round, but every normally allowed repeat save still occurs. EVOCATION: when casting an area Evocation spell, exclude one creature from its initial damaging area; that creature automatically succeeds and takes no damage if success normally halves damage. ILLUSION: gain +2 on concentration saves made to maintain Illusion spells. NECROMANCY: once per turn during a real encounter when a hostile non-summoned creature dies from your Necromancy spell, gain 1 temporary HP; it is not permanent healing. TRANSMUTATION: after casting a Transmutation spell, gain +5 feet Speed until the end of that turn.
RITUAL CASTING is automatic at Wizard 2. A Wizard spell in your spellbook with the Ritual tag can be cast from the book without being prepared by increasing its casting time by at least 10 minutes. A ritual cast costs 0 RP unless that ritual explicitly lists a consumed RP cost, cannot be used during an encounter and cannot generate or vent Dissonance through ordinary casting strain.
MATRIX MASTERY MODIFICATIONS. After acquiring Matrix Mastery, each prepared ordinary spell matrix may carry at most one modification chosen during preparation. QUICK SUBSTITUTION: once per short rest, replace one matrix marked Quick Substitution with another spellbook spell of exactly the same rank using a 1-minute ritual instead of the normal 10-minute midday swap; the replacement loses the modification until the next long rest. COMPONENT ENHANCEMENT: when casting a damaging or healing matrix, spend 1 additional RP to add one extra die of the spell's primary damage or healing die to one roll; if the spell has no such die this modification has no effect. MATRIX LINKING: pair two different prepared matrix families during preparation; after legally casting one, the other costs 1 less RP, minimum 1, if cast before the end of your next regular turn, at most once per pair per round. STABILITY REINFORCEMENT: gain +2 on concentration saves caused by damage while maintaining that matrix. A matrix modification never creates another spell cast or proc event.
NECROMANCER STANDARD UNDEAD. Corpse Harvest and Auto-Raise share a maximum of three standard raised minions. Skeleton: AC 14, HP 6 + 2 × Wizard level, Speed 30; Bone Shot, range 30 feet, Wizard spell attack, 1d6+S necrotic. Zombie: AC 12, HP 10 + 3 × Wizard level, Speed 20; Slam, reach 5 feet, Wizard spell attack, 1d8+S necrotic. Goblin Thrall, available only from a goblinoid corpse: AC 13, HP 8 + 2 × Wizard level, Speed 30; Shiv, reach 5 feet, Wizard spell attack, 1d6+S necrotic. These are pre-Flesh-Ascendant statistics.
ELITE UNDEAD PETS. Necromancers may bind Boneflayer, Dreadblade and Wraithbound, at most one of each and three elite pets total. They use the same shared Companion Command limit as standard undead. Boneflayer: AC 14, HP 12 + 2 × Wizard level, Speed 30. Bone Shards: range 60, Wizard spell attack, 2d6+S necrotic. Fear Pulse replaces its attack: enemies within 10 feet make Wisdom saves; failure Frightened until end of next turn; recharge 3. Grave Miasma replaces its attack: 10-foot-radius point within 30 feet until start of your next turn; enemies entering or starting there take 1d6 necrotic once; recharge 3.
Dreadblade: AC 16, HP 16 + 3 × Wizard level, Speed 30. Disrupting Blade: reach 5 feet, Wizard spell attack, 1d8+S necrotic; a concentrating target immediately makes its concentration save with disadvantage. On a natural 20 the target is Weakened until the end of its next turn, taking -1 on attack rolls. Dreadblade has advantage on saves against forced movement.
Wraithbound: AC 14, HP 10 + 2 × Wizard level, Fly 40 and hover. While it has not attacked or imposed control since the end of its previous turn it is Invisible; attacking ends that state until the end of its next turn. Wraith Strike: reach 5 feet, Wizard spell attack, 1d8+S necrotic. On natural 20 the target makes a Constitution save against your Wizard DC; failure Stuns until the end of its next turn.
Flesh Ascendant's bonus applies after the listed base statistics: every undead creature you control gains +2 maximum HP per Wizard level. If at least two of your undead creatures are active, each gains +1 AC and +1 on saving throws. This does not increase the standard-minion or elite-pet caps.
PROPOSED ACQUISITION. Wizard 1 automatically gains Arcane School Specialization, Spell Matrix System and the starting spellbook, then chooses 4 selectable Base cards, at least 2 Active. Wizard 2 automatically gains Counterspell and Ritual Casting, then chooses 2 additional selectable Base cards. Counterspell is not also placed in the Arch selection pool.

## Ordinary healing arithmetic

Determine legal source, recipients, costs, clocks and available entitlements before arithmetic. The helper receives already eligible modifiers; it does not acquire class powers or validate every source for its caller.

Pre-resolution modifiers include Words of Equilibrium's formula M, Zealot's Fervor +S, Throne's Grace +1/die capped S+M, Benevolent Spirits' eligible paid-technique +M, Life Prophecy maximizing dice, and Crane's applicable +S. Conditional add-ons include Ground, Radiance, Aura of Faith, Ember Mantle, Life Linked's rolled1d4, Ranger Healing Touch, Aura of Mercy, Garden's stored+1 and Tranquil Lotus Step.

First compute without conditional add-ons. Only if this preview actually restores at least1HP, recompute that same event once with its eligible add-ons. The preview changes no pools/uses. Base5 minus5 plus a conditional3 remains0; eligible pre-resolution Benevolent3 yields3. Multiple flat class bonuses use the strongest across both passes unless an explicit source exception allows stacking. Rolled extra dice/per-die changes are separate.

Within each permitted reduction plan: formula/bonuses; per-die adjustments; compatible exact fractional multipliers with one floor after multiplication; compatible flat reductions; floor at0; broad HP prohibition; maximum/Critical/reserve caps. Intrinsic Wound Eater and systemic Corrupted remain independent factors. Duplicate same-stat per-die penalties use the strongest. Dice remain dice when maximized/shared; flat Lay on Hands and stored numeric Echoes have zero healing dice.

Blight Totem cannot compound other local healing reducers. Compare systemic factors plus Totem-half alone against systemic factors plus all otherwise compatible local reducers; use the lower result. Compatible halves multiply, compatible distinct flat penalties add, duplicate same-profile groups use strongest. Suppressed reducers do not participate.

Every present, operative, applicable next-positive-healing reduction consumes exactly once when the final event commits if its pre-reduction HP potential was positive. This includes reducers whose arithmetic branch lost to Totem or whose actual gain was later blocked. Zero potential and suppressed records consume none. Two-pass preview never consumes twice.

Critical at3Wounds caps ordinary healing at max(1, effective maximum minus1); it is not a maximumHP reduction and healing cannot lower currentHP. Reserve spends only actualHP restored. A final heal8 with room3 spends3 reserve; blocked healing spends0, other activation costs remain paid. Revival/form changes/encounter starts do not replenish reserve.

## Recovery gates, triggers and loops

False Life curse gates another creature's healing SPELL: optional Insight vs RevelationDC; success permits; failed or declined check rolls d2,1 blocks HP and2 permits. Nonspell recovery and independent nonHP components remain distinct. Burning Blood blocks the cold-tagged HP-healing component only, not independent tempHP/stabilization/resurrection.

Actual positiveHP restoration is required for Radiance's cure, Renewal's Stamina, Sanctified Reprisal and Life Prophecy's RC trigger. Meditative Healing's laterKi and Transcendent Meditation's second-pulseKi are independent components and still resolve when healing caps/blocks. Blood Tithe uses its actual qualifying hostile Bleed-death trigger and finite use; not staged farming.

Passive regeneration includes Bloodthick Node, Rapid Coagulation, Regenerative Mutation and Bio-Stabilizer's modification; these retain Reserve. Finite paid/limited pulses such as Aura of Grace, Living Pulse, Renewal Totem, Blood Feast, Exsanguinate, Hemostasis, Transcendent Meditation, Cellular Reconstruction and Adrenal Floodgate are not passive regeneration. Their own Downed/Incapacitated gates remain. A passive-regeneration prohibition is not a universal healing prohibition.

Lay on Hands retains its5×Paladin-level finite pool and ordinary Long Rest refill. Base Action spends at most level on one target; Hero1/LR spends the entire remaining pool across at most3, each allocation at least1. No RP conversion. Verdict Absolute's explicit qualifying brand-kill refill is a source exception. **Remainder-conference amendment — engine[13] cadence reconciliation:** level17 Wave is1/long rest, superseding the preserved Hero card and earlier guide's1/short-rest wording. This follows the explicit engine reconciliation; the old source remains intact. Wider pool/recharge execution still belongs to the resource pass.

Transfusion donor spends K normalHP; recipient ordinary base is K+floor(K/2). Channel Life spends X; baseX. Donor must remain at least1, tempHP cannot pay, loss is not damage and cannot be prevented/redirected/refunded when recipient gets0. Recipient legal bonuses/reductions apply.

Secondary healing retains root ID and visited application IDs in a shared causal ledger, including across sibling branches. Each link/application can fire at most once/root. Numeric add-ons remain the same packet, creating no new root/child. Legal finite primary healing may trigger unrelated eligible effects.

Stronger source flags override generic provenance: Vitality Link's child blocks every further link; Echo Leech blocks secondary healing/resource triggers; Blood Feast blocks damage/resource triggers; Merciful Smite blocks Smite/heal-copy chains; Crown Undying blocks redirection/heal-copy chains; Echoes/Spiral copies retain their explicit exclusions. Source payment and direct/actual-gain predicates still apply before a child exists.

## Excess healing

OrdinaryMissingHP = effective maximum minus currentHP. Genuine excess is max(0, legal post-reduction healing minus OrdinaryMissingHP). Broad HP prohibition makes legal healing and excess0. Critical's ceiling does not redefine missingHP: max20/HP19/Critical/legalheal10 restores0 but has9 genuine excess; the missing1 is not excess. At HP20, legalheal10 has10 excess.

This quantity alone grants no conversion. A legal converter must satisfy its own costs/caps/cadences. One excess point can fund only one conversion. Source-internal Overflowing Light resolves before outside Cosmic Equilibrium uses remaining excess. Channel Life attaches a packet-wide prohibition on ALL excess-to-tempHP conversion, including another owner's feature. It permits an otherwise eligible Cosmic damage conversion.

**NEW agreed source exclusion:** Unpaid passive regeneration bounded by Mutation Recovery Reserve cannot supply excess-healing conversions unless a future source explicitly grants an exception. This covers Bloodthick Node, Rapid Coagulation, Regenerative Mutation and Bio-Stabilizer as a Bloodthick modifier. FullHP/Critical may compute mathematical excess but grants no Cosmic conversion and spends no Reserve. Do not extend this exclusion to otherwise eligible paid/finite healing merely because it restores0HP.

## Temporal dependency and validation boundary

Spiral-TouchedV Time Loop is temporal restoration, not generic resurrection. Its discussed participant contract restores recorded position, life/death/HP/temp/counters, Wounds/linked Injuries, Core/custom conditions, RC, per-encounter uses and snapshot Soul Bind state. Post-snapshot death/body destruction is conceptually undone; already-dead-at-snapshot remains dead. Generic corpse-resurrection denial does not automatically block it.

It does not restore RP/Ki/Conviction/BG, device resources, Mutation Reserve, daily/rest uses, physical consumables or its own spent use. The helper tests that field distinction only. Full equipment/environment topology, corpse/body-part duplication and clock rebasing remain in the dedicated temporal package; Time Loop is not declared fully operational by these tests.

Wisdom governs spells, form attacks and class DC/M. Hit Die d8; book armor, weapons, saves and skills remain. Retain your own ability scores, HP, saves, proficiency and personality in all forms; form traits replace only the stated anatomy, movement and attacks. No additional monster stat block or separate beast HP pool. One natural attack per Attack Action unless a form explicitly states otherwise, attack PB+WIS, printed dice+WIS damage. Missing natural attack is 1d6 bludgeoning; default walking Speed 30 ft, normal AC, Medium size. Hawk is Tiny, Bear/Earth Warden/hero forms may be Large when space permits. Equipment melds and cannot be used while melded; magical numeric bonuses persist only if compatible with form anatomy and never duplicate armor.
This class follows its explicit book progression instead of the ordinary 25-choice template. Base 1 grants Druidic, spellcasting, all five Base forms and 2 shifts/long rest. Choose one of seven Circles at 2; its level 2 features are a Base-stage exception. Enter the chosen Circle Arch path at 3, gain its 6 feature, then Circle Hero forms at 10 and its 14 feature. Arch Forms unlock 11 despite the historical word Arch; these are forms, not a second promotion. At 11 attune up to 2 Arch forms during long rest. Base forms remain available at higher levels. All features below are automatic at their gate for the chosen Circle; no generic extra class-card choices are added.
Shifting: Bonus Action, one long-rest shift use, 10 minutes, early reversion Bonus Action. Reaching 0 HP or incapacitation ends form; excess damage stays on your own HP. Shift uses follow detailed book table:2 at 1, 3 at 4, 4 at 7, 5 at 10, 6 at 13, 7 at 16, 8 at 19. Supplemental runtime alternative 2/3/4/5/6 at 1/4/8/12/16 remains preserved. At 20 changing form is unlimited but does not refill finite form benefits. Speech unavailable in Base forms, available in Arch/Hero. No spellcasting in form until Beast Spells 18 except an explicit form permission. Maintaining an existing spell concentration is allowed, still only one concentration. Changing form spends a use and ends old form features/summons; it does not reset once/rest abilities.
Transformation reserves prevent unlimited replacement HP: at long rest record Buffer Reserve=2 L+M and Form Surge Reserve=PB. A form giving temporary HP draws that many from Buffer Reserve, up to remaining amount, with normal nonstacking; never real healing. A form special described once/transformation also spends 1 Form Surge and cannot be refreshed by resuming the form. Form Surge refills only long rest. Forms cannot grant free casts, RP or shift uses. Auras affect at most 3 enemies and once per enemy per round; retaliation once/round total; ongoing riders refresh, never stack. Entering a legal Shapeshift clears the Refrain counter and remembered repeated-spell name, as the protected source contract requires. It does not reduce accumulated Dissonance. Natural attacks do not clear Refrain.
Circle of the Land chooses one terrain at 2. Always-prepared spell pairs at 3/5/7/9 are exactly the source table lines 2662–2669, reproduced in source appendix; their source names resolve to existing approved spell entries before use. They do not bypass rank gates. For this pilot Circle spells are permitted exceptions to ordinary list membership, not newly authored variants. Moon Circle Forms CR table is historical external-stat language: use only these bounded forms, not arbitrary CR beasts. Early Moon benefit is +S damage on first form hit each turn. No imported monster multiattack, spellcasting or legendary actions.
Circle summary: Land preserves lore and recovery; Moon improves shifting; Storm controls lightning and wind; Thorns works poison and roots; Winterfang works cold; Rotshaper uses bounded swarms; Ashen Grove works fire and regrowth. Land/Thorns duplicate Blight Elk and Tanglemaw names are kept as separate source identities. Source auto-failed hostile saves in Master of Decay/Ash become once/turn-2 on one save, not unavoidable control. Stronger supplemental flavor riders are represented explicitly below or retained as unadopted alternatives in source provenance.

def ref(fragment,pointer='',where=None):
    hits=[b for b in bindings if fragment in b['member'] and (not where or b['id'].startswith(where))]
    if len(hits)!=1: raise ValueError((fragment,[b['member'] for b in hits]))
    return {'sourceId':hits[0]['id'],'pointer':pointer}

class Scene:
    def __init__(self,id,sid,title,defs,states,geometry=None,holds=None):
        self.id=id;self.sid=sid;self.defs=copy.deepcopy(defs)
        self.s={'time':0,'actors':copy.deepcopy(states),'effects':{},'objects':{},'receipts':{'casts':{},'damage':{},'hard':{},'events':{},'extensions':{},'ground':{}},'privateKnowledge':{}}
        self.initial=None;self.timeline=[];self.branches=[];self.geometry=geometry or {'floor':'level z0','opaqueObstacles':[],'lineOfEffect':'clear except explicit recorded obstacle','units':'Euclidean feet; actual closed occupied volumes'}
        self.title=title;self.holds=holds or []
    def seal(self): self.initial=copy.deepcopy(self.s);return self
    def auto(self,t):
        notes=[]
        # Only ordinary provided clock/budget/idle cadence is calculated here. Source-specific rolls/endings are explicit events.
        while True:
            candidates=[(a[key],0 if key=='nextSTART' else 1,aid,key) for aid,a in self.s['actors'].items() if a['life']!='removed' for key in ['nextSTART','nextEND'] if a[key]<=t+1e-9]
            if not candidates: break
            when,_,aid,key=min(candidates)
            a=self.s['actors'][aid]
            if key=='nextSTART':
                a.update(previousSTART=when,nextSTART=round(when+6,6),action=True,bonusAction=True,reaction=True,movementSpent=0,turnHadMagic=False,turnId=aid+'@'+str(when))
                if a['uses'].get('classCounterspellRecharge',0)>0:a['uses']['classCounterspellRecharge']-=1
                notes.append({'time':when,'actor':aid,'kind':'actual supplied regular START','actionRefreshed':True,'reactionRefreshed':True})
            else:
                old=a['Dissonance']
                if not a['turnHadMagic']:a['Dissonance']=max(0,a['Dissonance']-1)
                a['nextEND']=round(when+6,6)
                notes.append({'time':when,'actor':aid,'kind':'regular END clock/idle accounting only','DissonanceBefore':old,'DissonanceAfter':a['Dissonance'],'sourceSavesAndExpiry':'Any due named spell processing is independently explicit; this clock does not invent save outcomes.'})
        return notes
    def E(self,t,label,fun=lambda s:None,detail=None):
        before=copy.deepcopy(self.s)
        notes=self.auto(t)
        self.s['time']=t
        result=fun(self.s)
        self.timeline.append({'index':len(self.timeline),'time':t,'description':label,'before':before,'scheduledBudgetProcessing':notes,'detail':detail or {},'resolution':result,'after':copy.deepcopy(self.s)})
        return result
    def done(self):
        if self.initial is None:self.seal()
        c={'id':self.id,'spellId':self.sid,'title':self.title,'disposition':'WHOLE_POSITIVE_CASE_CONDITIONAL_CONTENT_HOLD' if self.holds else 'COHERENT_AUTHORED_SCENARIO_AT_DISCLOSED_INPUTS',
           'fixtureType':'NEW source-qualified synthetic scene; not campaign authentication or engine execution',
           'actorDefinitions':self.defs,'geometry':self.geometry,'initialState':self.initial,'timeline':self.timeline,
           'expectedFinalState':copy.deepcopy(self.s),'independentBranches':self.branches,'holds':self.holds,
           'scope':'Explicit fixture regular markers are inputs, not a new timestamp-to-round law. Automatic listings calculate only shown budget/idle updates. All actual condition/save/damage consequences needed for this encounter are stated separately.',
           'sourceRefs':[{'archive':ARCH['S'].name,'member':'CANDIDATE.json','pointer':f'/records/{[r["spellId"] for r in C["records"]].index(self.sid)}'},
             {'file':'PROCEDURES.json','pointer':f'/procedures/{[r["spellId"] for r in C["records"]].index(self.sid)}'},ref('accepted_interface_registry_06.json','/entries')],
           'runtimeExecuted':False}
        cases.append(c);return c
def roll(s,aid,ability,die,dc,penalty=0):
    a=s['actors'][aid];total=die+a['saveBonuses'][ability]+penalty
    return {'ability':ability,'d20':die,'modifier':a['saveBonuses'][ability],'other':penalty,'total':total,'DC':dc,'success':total>=dc}
def spend(s,aid,kind):

def cast(s,aid,sid,cid,conc=False,rank=None,cost=None,school=None,kind='action'):
    a=s['actors'][aid]
    if rank is None: rank=cat_by[sid]['classAccess'][a['class']]['rank']
    if cost is None: cost=cat_by[sid]['classAccess'][a['class']]['baseRpCost']
    if school is None: school=cat_by[sid]['classAccess'][a['class']]['school']
    assert a['Dissonance']<17 and a['RP']>=cost
    spend(s,aid,kind);oldRP=a['RP'];a['RP']-=cost
    oldCon=a['concentration']
    if conc:
        if oldCon and oldCon in s['effects']:end_effect(s,oldCon,'displaced at new commitment')
        a['concentration']=cid
    rep=min(3,a['Refrain']+1) if a['lastSpell']==sid else 0
    base=0 if rank==0 else 1 if rank<=5 else 2
    waiver=a['class']=='Wizard' and sid not in a['matrixFamiliesUsed']
    if waiver:base=0
    a['Dissonance']+=base+rep;a['lastSpell']=sid;a['Refrain']=rep
    if a['class']=='Wizard' and sid not in a['matrixFamiliesUsed']:a['matrixFamiliesUsed'].append(sid)
    a['turnHadMagic']=True
    rec={'id':cid,'owner':aid,'spellId':sid,'rank':rank,'school':school,'RPBefore':oldRP,'paidBase':cost,'RPAfter':a['RP'],'baseDissonance':base,'RefrainAdded':rep,'time':s['time'],'concentrationDisplaced':oldCon if conc else None,'status':'paid-pending','nullAtDamage':'Only actual later creation-qualified source; none in these baseline fixtures'}
    s['receipts']['casts'][cid]=rec;return copy.deepcopy(rec)
def resolved(s,cid):
    s['receipts']['casts'][cid]['status']='resolved'
def condition(s,aid,name,eid,deadline=None,**fields):
    c={'name':name,'sourceId':eid,'deadline':deadline,**fields};s['actors'][aid]['conditions'].append(c)
    if name in ['Slow','PainHalf']:s['actors'][aid]['Speed']=s['actors'][aid]['normalSpeed']//2
    if name=='RimeSlow':s['actors'][aid]['Speed']=max(0,s['actors'][aid]['normalSpeed']-10)
    if name in ['Stunned','MindMaze','Grappled']:s['actors'][aid]['Speed']=0
    if name=='Stunned' and s['actors'][aid]['concentration']:
        end_effect(s,s['actors'][aid]['concentration'],'actual Stunned incapacity')
    return c
def clear_source(s,eid):
    for aid,a in s['actors'].items():
        a['conditions']=[c for c in a['conditions'] if c['sourceId']!=eid]
        speeds=[a['normalSpeed']]
        for c in a['conditions']:
            if c['name'] in ['Slow','PainHalf']:speeds.append(a['normalSpeed']//2)
            elif c['name']=='RimeSlow':speeds.append(max(0,a['normalSpeed']-10))
            elif c['name'] in ['Stunned','MindMaze','Grappled']:speeds.append(0)
        a['Speed']=min(speeds)
        if a['concentration']==eid:a['concentration']=None
def end_effect(s,eid,reason):
    if eid in s['effects']:
        s['effects'][eid].update(status='ended',endTime=s['time'],endReason=reason)
    clear_source(s,eid)
def dmg(s,aid,dice,typ,root,owner,half=False,concDie=None,woundDie=None,notes=''):
    a=s['actors'][aid]
    raw=sum(dice);afterSave=raw//2 if half else raw
    defended=afterSave//2 if typ in a['resistances'] else afterSave
    absorbed=min(a['tempHP'],defended);a['tempHP']-=absorbed
    post=defended-absorbed;old=a['HP'];a['HP']=max(0,old-post)
    rec={'id':root,'dealer':owner,'target':aid,'dice':dice,'type':typ,'raw':raw,'saveHalf':half,'afterSave':afterSave,
         'resistanceApplied':typ in a['resistances'],'resolved':defended,'tempAbsorbed':absorbed,'normalHpLost':min(old,post),
         'overkill':max(0,post-old),'HPBefore':old,'HPAfter':a['HP'],'null':False,'notes':notes}
    # enforce exact meaningful wound evidence, no guessed roll.
    if post-old>=a['maxHP']:
        a['life']='dead';rec['instantDeath']=True
    elif (old>0 and a['HP']==0) or 2*post>=a['maxHP']:
        assert woundDie is not None,(root,'missing wound roll',post,a['maxHP'])
        dc=max(10,post//2);total=woundDie+a['saveBonuses']['CON']-a['Wounds']
        rec['wound']={'d20':woundDie,'CON':a['saveBonuses']['CON'],'preWounds':a['Wounds'],'DC':dc,'total':total,'success':total>=dc}
        if total<dc:
            a['Wounds']+=1
            if dc-total>=5:a['Injuries'].append({'linkedWound':a['Wounds'],'selection':'Actual injury-table result required; no such failure used in baseline'})
    if a['HP']==0 and a['life']!='dead':
        a['life']='dying';condition(s,aid,'Unconscious',root+'/zero');condition(s,aid,'Prone',root+'/zero')
        if a['concentration']:end_effect(s,a['concentration'],'actual zero-HP incapacity')
    elif a['concentration'] and defended>0:
        assert concDie is not None,(root,'missing concentration',a['concentration'])
        mod=a['saveBonuses']['CON']+(2 if a['class']=='Mage' else 0)
        dc=max(10,defended//2);total=concDie+mod-a['Wounds']
        rec['concentration']={'d20':concDie,'modIncludingClass':mod,'WoundPenalty':a['Wounds'],'DC':dc,'total':total,'success':total>=dc}
        if total<dc:end_effect(s,a['concentration'],'failed concentration save')
    s['receipts']['damage'][root]=rec;return rec
def make(id,sid,title,extra=(),mage=False,targets=1,form='natural',positions=None):
    wd=mage_def(sid) if mage else wizard_def(sid,extra=extra)
    defs={'C':wd};states={'C':act(wd)}
    for j in range(targets):
        aid='T' if targets==1 else 'T'+str(j+1)
        dd=druid_def(form=form);defs[aid]=dd
        pos=(positions[j] if positions else (30+j*7,0,0))
        states[aid]=act(dd,pos, start=-3+0.3*j,end=4+0.3*j)
    return Scene(id,sid,title,defs,states)

def condition(s,aid,name,eid,deadline=None,**fields):
    c={'name':name,'sourceId':eid,'deadline':deadline,**fields};s['actors'][aid]['conditions'].append(c)
    if name in ['Slow','PainHalf']:s['actors'][aid]['Speed']=s['actors'][aid]['normalSpeed']//2
    if name=='RimeSlow':s['actors'][aid]['Speed']=max(0,s['actors'][aid]['normalSpeed']-10)
    if name in ['Stunned','MindMaze','Grappled']:s['actors'][aid]['Speed']=0
    if name=='Stunned' and s['actors'][aid]['concentration']:
        end_effect(s,s['actors'][aid]['concentration'],'actual Stunned incapacity')
    return c
 def clear_source(s,eid):
    for aid,a in s['actors'].items():
        a['conditions']=[c for c in a['conditions'] if c['sourceId']!=eid]
        speeds=[a['normalSpeed']]
        for c in a['conditions']:
            if c['name'] in ['Slow','PainHalf']:speeds.append(a['normalSpeed']//2)
            elif c['name']=='RimeSlow':speeds.append(max(0,a['normalSpeed']-10))
            elif c['name'] in ['Stunned','MindMaze','Grappled']:speeds.append(0)
        a['Speed']=min(speeds)
        if a['concentration']==eid:a['concentration']=None

def clear_source(s,eid):
    for aid,a in s['actors'].items():
        a['conditions']=[c for c in a['conditions'] if c['sourceId']!=eid]
        speeds=[a['normalSpeed']]
        for c in a['conditions']:
            if c['name'] in ['Slow','PainHalf']:speeds.append(a['normalSpeed']//2)
            elif c['name']=='RimeSlow':speeds.append(max(0,a['normalSpeed']-10))
            elif c['name'] in ['Stunned','MindMaze','Grappled']:speeds.append(0)
        a['Speed']=min(speeds)
        if a['concentration']==eid:a['concentration']=None

Flat bonuses, riders and critical extra dice are not copied again.

On failure it proceeds normally. Counterspell is non-elemental and, because it is itself a spell, clears an active Nuke Chain.

At encounter end your original level-2 Focus automatically returns.
