## Targets, concentration and control
One concentration slot for all spells, Chants, Veinweaves, forms or zones that require concentration. Starting another ends the old before the new effect resolves, except for an explicit limited linked-effect rule. Damage prompts CON save against max(10, floor(damage/2)); incapacitation or a failed save ends concentration. The round-down convention is a deliberate pilot interpretation. Concentration does not demand a Bonus Action unless maintenance says so. For a paid 3-pulse effect, start is pulse 1; pay maintenance on each of the next 2 regular turns by turn end for pulses 2/3. Missing payment ends it at that turn's end; otherwise it ends at start of turn 4. No repeated start triggers on maintenance.
No damage/healing copy repeats the source's costs, procs, resource generation, critical bonus dice, buffs, actions, cooldown resets or duration. Compute fractions once, capped at 100% of one stored source unless an explicit card states a separately priced higher amount. Copies still cause ordinary damage consequences, concentration checks and death. A copy cannot copy another copy. A target/source record must refer to an actual resolved event, not merely a known ability name.
For a reproducible pilot, retain the protected **Dissonance** layer with Core V 2 numeric RP costs. This combination is a new integration decision: do not also roll a second historical Burn/fizzle system on top of it. Limit=max(4, 2+PB+max(0, casting modifier)). Before a ranked cast, Dissonance at limit/limit+3/limit+6 adds 1/2/3 RP respectively; at limit+6 ordinary casters cannot cast rank 1+. At limit+3 ordinary Overcast is unavailable. A cast then adds base Dissonance 0 at rank 0, 1 at ranks 1–5, 2 at ranks 6–9. Immediate repeated casts of the same named spell add 1, 2, then 3 maximum. Another named spell resets the repeat counter but not accumulated strain. Apply the class's exact cadence reduction/vent; never infer a free RP reduction. Printed class techniques pay printed costs and cause no automatic spell Dissonance unless tagged or expressly described as spells, Echo releases or Matrix casts. For a Mage/Wizard class card tagged as a spell, use the rank printed in normalized data; its rank is fixed at acquisition and does not rise with S. Other techniques are not counterspell able unless their card says so.
Retune recovers max(0, round(max RP/4)+casting modifier), never above maximum, and clears Dissonance. A long rest restores RP and clears Dissonance. Optional 10-minute meditation once/day recovers positive casting modifier RP and reduces Dissonance by PB+positive modifier. A regular turn with no spell or magical class ability loses 1 Dissonance; an Action spent Grounding without casting loses PB instead (not both). Merely ending an encounter does not clear accumulated Dissonance. Refrain survives idle/weapon turns unless a class explicitly clears it. PROVISIONAL PLAYTEST CONTRACT. Intelligence is the Wizard class ability. S = 1/2/3/4 at Wizard levels 1/5/11/17. M = max(1, Intelligence modifier). Wizard spell attack = d20 + normal character proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier. Wizard spell save DC = 8 + normal character proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier.
SPELLBOOK. At Wizard 1 your spellbook contains six chosen rank-1 Wizard spells. Arcane School Specialization also adds one legal rank-1 bonus spell of your chosen school without replacing one of those six. For this provisional progression, add 2 legal Wizard spells to the book at each Wizard level 2-4, 3 at each level 5-8, 4 at each level 9-12, 5 at each level 13-16 and 6 at each level 17-20. Level-up additions cost no money or scribing time.
PREPARED SPELL MATRIX. After a long rest, prepare a number of matrices equal to Wizard level + Intelligence modifier, minimum 1, selecting only spells currently recorded in your spellbook and within your legal rank. You cast ordinary Wizard spells only from prepared matrices unless a feature explicitly overrides that restriction. Preparing the full daily matrix set normally requires 1 hour of spellbook study. Matrix Efficiency reduces this to 45 minutes.
DUPLICATE PREPARATION. You may prepare the same spell more than once, primarily to carry different Matrix Mastery configurations. Duplicate copies never create additional first-cast Dissonance exemptions. For Refrain and the protected strain rule, all prepared copies sharing the same underlying spell name belong to one matrix family regardless of modification.
ABJURATION, provisional completion for the omitted eighth row: once per round after you cast an Abjuration spell, gain temporary HP equal to PB until the start of your next regular turn. CONJURATION: creatures summoned by your Wizard spells gain +1 maximum HP per Wizard level. DIVINATION: once per long rest reroll one failed saving throw and use the new result. ENCHANTMENT: when a creature fails its initial save against one of your Enchantment spells, a printed control duration of at least 1 round may last one additional round, but every normally allowed repeat save still occurs. EVOCATION: when casting an area Evocation spell, exclude one creature from its initial damaging area; that creature automatically succeeds and takes no damage if success normally halves damage. ILLUSION: gain +2 on concentration saves made to maintain Illusion spells. NECROMANCY: once per turn during a real encounter when a hostile non-summoned creature dies from your Necromancy spell, gain 1 temporary HP; it is not permanent healing. TRANSMUTATION: after casting a Transmutation spell, gain +5 feet Speed until the end of that turn.
PROTECTED DISSONANCE INTERFACE. The first cast of each different prepared matrix family during an encounter generates 0 BASE Dissonance. This exemption affects only base strain. Refrain and explicitly printed strain costs still apply; the suite disables generic Overcast and does not layer historical Burn onto Dissonance. Repeating a matrix family follows normal Refrain immediately. Preparing duplicates or differently modified copies of the same underlying spell never refreshes the exemption.
Core Systems V 2 Resonance Points and spell-rank RP costs are authoritative for Wizard spellcasting. There are no historical spell slots in this pilot. Wizard cards tagged wizard-spell are always-prepared class matrices once acquired, do not consume a daily prepared-matrix position and use the same RP, concentration, Refrain and protected first-distinct-matrix rules as other Wizard spells. Their printed RP cost replaces any generic rank cost; never pay both.
Only one concentration effect can normally be maintained. Starting a second concentration effect ends the first. Damage uses the current Core Systems concentration rule; required half-damage rounding is down for this pilot. Spell Tether and the level-17 Tethered Cast are the only Wizard-specific exceptions in this draft, and each has an explicit RP price, duration and one-tether cap.
Flesh Ascendant's bonus applies after the listed base statistics: every undead creature you control gains +2 maximum HP per Wizard level. If at least two of your undead creatures are active, each gains +1 AC and +1 on saving throws. This does not increase the standard-minion or elite-pet caps.
All acquisition gates use Wizard class level rather than total character level. Normal proficiency bonus follows the game's ordinary total-character-level rule. A multiclass dip cannot unlock higher spell ranks, Arcanist cards, Hero cards, Final Theorems or progression-table features.

def state_from(d,position,first_start=0,first_end=2,initial_time=0):
    # first_start denotes previous/current regular START; first_end is that turn's END.
    base=copy.deepcopy(CSTATE if d['class'] in ('Wizard','Mage') else DSTATE)
    base.update({'class':d['class'],'level':d['classLevel'],'PB':d['PB'],
        'HP':d['maxHp'],'maxHP':d['maxHp'],'effectiveMaxHP':d['maxHp'],'RP':d['maxRp'],'maxRP':d['maxRp'],
        'AC':d['AC'],'Speed':d['speedFeet'],'normalSpeed':d['speedFeet'],
        'position':list(position),'dimensions':d['bodyBoxFeet'],'saveBonuses':d['saves'],
        'abilityModifiers':{ab:(d[ab]-10)//2 for ab in ['STR','DEX','CON','INT','WIS','CHA']},
        'previousSTART':first_start,'nextSTART':round(first_start+6,6),
        'previousEND':round(first_end-6,6) if first_end>initial_time else first_end,
        'nextEND':first_end if first_end>initial_time else round(first_end+6,6),
        'regularTurnActive':first_start<=initial_time<first_end,
        'turnId':f"{d['class']}@{first_start}",'knownEnemies':[],
        'resistances':['fire'] if d['class']=='Wizard' else (['lightning'] if d['class']=='Mage' else []),
        'uses':{'classCounterspellRecharge':0} if d['class']=='Wizard' else
               ({'metamagicUses':1,'resonanceSurgeUses':1,'focusArcUsedByTurn':{}} if d['class']=='Mage' else copy.deepcopy(DSTATE['uses'])),
        'focusChain':[] if d['class']=='Mage' else None,'outOfTurnMagicEvents':[]})
    return base

def fresh_case(cid,sid,title,positions,kind='Wizard',extra_actors=None,initial_time=0,
               target_schedule=None):
    defs={'C':wizard_variant(sid) if kind=='Wizard' else mage_variant()}
    states={'C':state_from(defs['C'],[0,0,0],initial_time,initial_time+2,initial_time)}
    for i,pos in enumerate(positions):
        aid='T' if len(positions)==1 else f'T{i+1}'
        defs[aid]=copy.deepcopy(DDEF)
        defs[aid]['actualPreparationPremise']='Actual previously prepared listed sources are fixture inputs; targets cast none in Part B.'
        st=round(initial_time-3+0.3*i,6);en=round(initial_time-2+0.3*i,6)
        if target_schedule and aid in target_schedule:st,en=target_schedule[aid]
        states[aid]=state_from(defs[aid],pos,st,en,initial_time)
        states[aid]['knownEnemies']=['C']
    for aid,d,pos,st,en in (extra_actors or []):
        defs[aid]=d;states[aid]=state_from(d,pos,st,en,initial_time)
    states['C']['knownEnemies']=[a for a in states if a.startswith('T')]
    state={'time':initial_time,'actors':states,'effects':{},'objects':{},
        'receipts':{'casts':{},'damage':{},'completedEvents':{},'hardControl':{},'children':{},'terminals':{}},
        'privateKnowledge':{'disclosure':'RNG, sets and immutable internal IDs are Director/engine evidence, not a sixth DE4 presentation.'},
        'world':{'floor':'supported z0 except explicit geometry','encounterId':cid+'/encounter',
                 'roundSchedule':'This finite fixture supplies6-second repeating regular START/END markers; no new global scheduler rule.',
                 'externalActions':'No extra turn, off-turn movement or additional Reaction provider.'}}
    return {'id':cid,'spellId':sid,'title':title,'status':'RECONSTRUCTED_PART_B_DRAFT_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW',
       'fixtureType':'complete source-qualified synthetic encounter, not authenticated campaign/world or runtime',
       'actorDefinitions':defs,'geometry':{'units':'feet; recovered spell-local continuous convention',
       'footAnchor':'x/y footprint center,zbottom; dimensions describe actual occupied axis-aligned box for this fixture',
       'opaqueObstacles':[],'support':'level floorz0','otherActors':'none','lineOfEffect':'clear unless explicitly blocked',
       'physicalScope':'No implicit change from occupied boxes to display bounding boxes.'},
       'initialState':copy.deepcopy(state),'timeline':[],'expectedFinalState':None,'independentBranches':[],
       'externalPremises':['Actual lawful class/card/book acquisition and usable carried focus are disclosed synthetic inputs.',
           'Actual sources, life state, opposition, open scene and provided schedule are not created by passing arithmetic.',
           'All optional interventions not specifically supplied are declined; no interrupted outcome implies an invented provider.'],
       'reconstructionNotes':[],'sourceReferences':[
           {'archive':'original-source','member':'CANDIDATE.json','pointer':f"/records/{next(i for i,r in enumerate(src_candidate['records']) if r['spellId']==sid)}"},
           {'file':'inherited/PROCEDURES.json','pointer':f"/procedures/{next(i for i,p in enumerate(aproc['procedures']) if p['id']==sid)}"}],
       'runtimeExecuted':False,'_s':state}

def set_initial(case):
    case['initialState']=copy.deepcopy(case['_s'])
def recompute_speed(a):
    vals=[a['normalSpeed']]
    for c in a['conditions']:
        if c['name']=='RimeSlow':vals.append(max(0,a['normalSpeed']-10))
        if c['name'] in ('Stunned','Grappled'):vals.append(0)
    a['Speed']=min(vals)
def scheduled_to(s,t):
    """New, finite fixture expansion only: actual supplied STARTs/ENDs and rider deadlines."""
    report=[]
    while True:
        due=[]
        for aid,a in s['actors'].items():
            for k in ('nextSTART','nextEND'):
                if a[k]<=t+1e-8: due.append((a[k],0 if k=='nextSTART' else 2,aid,k))
            for i,c in enumerate(a['conditions']):
                if c.get('deadline') is not None and c['deadline']<=t+1e-8:
                    due.append((c['deadline'],1,aid,'condition:'+c['sourceId']))
        if not due: break
        tm,_,aid,kind=sorted(due)[0];a=s['actors'][aid];before=copy.deepcopy(a)
        if kind=='nextSTART':
            a.update(previousSTART=tm,nextSTART=round(tm+6,6),regularTurnActive=True,
                action=True,bonusAction=True,reaction=True,movementSpent=0,dashMovementGranted=0,
                turnHadMagic=False,turnId=f'{aid}@{tm}')
            if 'classCounterspellRecharge' in a['uses']:
                a['uses']['classCounterspellRecharge']=max(0,a['uses']['classCounterspellRecharge']-1)
        elif kind=='nextEND':
            if not a['turnHadMagic']: a['Dissonance']=max(0,a['Dissonance']-1)
            a.update(previousEND=tm,nextEND=round(tm+6,6),regularTurnActive=False)
        else:
            ss=kind.split(':',1)[1]
            a['conditions']=[q for q in a['conditions'] if q['sourceId']!=ss]
            recompute_speed(a)
        report.append({'time':tm,'actor':aid,'event':kind,'beforeActor':before,'afterActor':copy.deepcopy(a),
                       'source':'actual supplied regular markers or explicitly fixed one-future-END rider; no extra turn or save'})
    s['time']=t
    return report

def event(c,t,desc,change,inputs=None):
    s=c['_s'];before=copy.deepcopy(s)
    ck(c['id']+':monotonic:'+str(len(c['timeline'])),t>=s['time'],category='reconstruction')
    processed=scheduled_to(s,round(t,6));pre=copy.deepcopy(s)
    resolution=change(s)
    eid=c['id']+'/event/'+str(len(c['timeline']))
    s['receipts']['completedEvents'][eid]={'time':t,'processedOnce':True}
    c['timeline'].append({'index':len(c['timeline']),'id':eid,'time':t,'description':desc,
        'before':before,'scheduledProcessing':processed,'stateAtEventAfterScheduledProcessing':pre,
        'inputsAndSourceQualification':inputs or {},'resolution':copy.deepcopy(resolution),'after':copy.deepcopy(s)})
def finish_case(c):
    c['expectedFinalState']=copy.deepcopy(c['_s']);del c['_s'];return c
def debit(s,aid,budget):
    a=s['actors'][aid];assert a[budget]
    if budget in ('action','bonusAction'):assert a['regularTurnActive']
    assert not any(q['name']=='Stunned' for q in a['conditions'])
    a[budget]=False
def magic_mark(a,time):
    if a['regularTurnActive']:a['turnHadMagic']=True
    else:a['outOfTurnMagicEvents'].append({'time':time,'kind':'actual committed magical spell'})
def pay(s,aid,sid,cid,concentration=False,budget='action'):
    a=s['actors'][aid]
    access=cat_lookup[sid]['classAccess'][a['class']]
    rank=access['rank'];base=access['baseRpCost'];assert a['Dissonance']<17
    surcharge=0 if a['Dissonance']<11 else 1 if a['Dissonance']<14 else 2
    cost=base+surcharge;assert a['RP']>=cost
    debit(s,aid,budget)
    oldRP=a['RP'];oldD=a['Dissonance'];a['RP']-=cost
    rep=min(3,a['Refrain']+1) if a['lastSpell']==sid else 0
    exempt=a['class']=='Wizard' and sid not in a['matrixFamiliesUsed']
    ds=0 if exempt or rank==0 else 1 if rank<=5 else 2
    a['Dissonance']+=ds+rep;a['lastSpell']=sid;a['Refrain']=rep
    if a['class']=='Wizard' and sid not in a['matrixFamiliesUsed']:a['matrixFamiliesUsed'].append(sid)
    oldconc=a['concentration']
    if concentration:
        if oldconc:
            if oldconc in s['effects']:s['effects'][oldconc].update(status='ended',endTime=s['time'],endReason='displaced at new paid commitment')
        a['concentration']=cid
    magic_mark(a,s['time'])
    rec={'id':cid,'owner':aid,'spellId':sid,'school':access['school'],'rank':rank,'budget':budget,
        'RPBefore':oldRP,'paidBase':base,'additionalRP':surcharge,'RPAfter':a['RP'],
        'DissonanceBefore':oldD,'baseDissonance':ds,'RefrainAdded':rep,'DissonanceAfter':a['Dissonance'],
        'protectedFirstPreparedFamilyUsed':exempt,'time':s['time'],'components':'actual V/S/F performed once',
        'concentrationBefore':oldconc,'concentrationAfter':a['concentration'],
        'status':'paid-pending','counterWindow':'only this actual casting commitment',
        'classMode':'ordinary learned/prepared spell; not the same-named class card'}
    s['receipts']['casts'][cid]=rec
    return copy.deepcopy(rec)
def establish_b(s,eid,sid,owner='C',**fields):
    s['receipts']['casts'][eid]['status']='resolved'
    rec={'id':eid,'spellId':sid,'owner':owner,'status':'active','establishedAt':s['time'],
         'deadline':round(s['time']+60,6),**fields}
    s['effects'][eid]=rec
    return copy.deepcopy(rec)
def save_roll(s,aid,ability,die,dc):
    a=s['actors'][aid];mod=a['saveBonuses'][ability]-(a['Wounds'] if ability=='CON' else 0)
    return {'actor':aid,'ability':ability,'die':die,'modifier':mod,'DC':dc,'total':die+mod,
            'success':die+mod>=dc,'actualProficiencyIncludedOnce':True,'noNatural1or20SaveRule':True}
def damage(s,aid,dice,sides,typ,root,owner='C',half=False,shared=None):
    a=s['actors'][aid];assert root not in s['receipts']['damage']
    assert all(isinstance(x,int) and 1<=x<=sides for x in dice)
    raw=sum(dice);sv=raw//2 if half else raw
    de=sv//2 if typ in a['resistances'] else sv
    tb=a['tempHP'];absorb=min(tb,de);a['tempHP']-=absorb
    old=a['HP'];post=de-absorb;a['HP']=max(0,old-post)
    assert a['HP']>0 and 2*post<a['maxHP'] # all authored B packets deliberately below Wound threshold
    assert a['concentration'] is None # no concentrating damage recipient in this finite set
    rec={'id':root,'originalDealer':owner,'recipient':aid,'createdAt':s['time'],'dice':list(dice),
        'dieSides':sides,'raw':raw,'saveHalf':half,'afterSave':sv,'type':typ,
        'resistanceApplied':typ in a['resistances'],'resolvedDamage':de,'tempBefore':tb,'tempAbsorbed':absorb,
        'tempAfter':a['tempHP'],'normalHPBefore':old,'postTempDamage':post,'normalHPLost':min(post,old),
        'overkill':max(0,post-old),'normalHPAfter':a['HP'],'rootNull':False,
        'NullQualification':'No qualifying Null source; actual dealer and creation checkpoint retained.',
        'WoundRequired':False,'woundReason':'Positive HP remains and each post-temp packet is below half maximum; no Maiming.',
        'concentrationCheckRequired':False,'concentrationReason':'Recipient maintains no concentration.',
        'sharedPoolId':shared}
    s['receipts']['damage'][root]=rec
    return copy.deepcopy(rec)
def rider(s,aid,name,source,deadline,**more):
    a=s['actors'][aid];a['conditions'].append({'name':name,'sourceId':source,'deadline':deadline,**more})
    recompute_speed(a)
def end_b(s,eid,reason):
    e=s['effects'][eid];assert e['status'] not in ('ended','countered')
    e.update(status='ended',endedAt=s['time'],endReason=reason)
    for a in s['actors'].values():
        if a['concentration']==eid:a['concentration']=None
    return copy.deepcopy(e)

    owner=s['actors']['C']

def commit_mote(s,eid,shotid,target='T'):
    e=s['effects'][eid];a=s['actors']['C']
    assert e['status']=='active' and s['time']<e['deadline'] and e['motes']>0
    # Positive case supplied actual perception and unobstructed within120; independently audited later.
    debit(s,'C','bonusAction')
    e['motes']-=1
    rec={'id':shotid,'owner':'C','target':target,'parent':eid,'state':'committed',
         'committedAt':s['time'],'sourceDeadline':e['deadline'],'BApaid':True,'moteSpent':1,
         'remainingMotes':e['motes'],'separateFromParentExhaustion':True,'anotherCasting':False}
    s['receipts']['children'][shotid]=rec
    e.setdefault('pendingShots',{})[shotid]=copy.deepcopy(rec)
    if not e['motes']: e['status']='exhausted-payload-pending'
    return copy.deepcopy(rec)
def settle_mote(s,eid,shotid,die,dice):
    e=s['effects'][eid];child=s['receipts']['children'][shotid];a=s['actors']['C']
    if child['state']=='settled':
        return {'childAlreadySettled':True,'additionalBA':False,'additionalDice':[],'additionalDamage':0,
                'parentStatus':e['status'],'motes':e['motes']}
    target=s['actors'][child['target']]
    hit=die==20 or die!=1 and die+11>=target['AC'];critical=die==20
    if not hit:assert dice==[]
    else:assert len(dice)==(8 if critical else 4)
    parent_before=e['status']
    result=damage(s,child['target'],dice,12,'radiant',shotid+'/root') if hit else None
    child.update(state='settled',settledAt=s['time'],attackDie=die,hit=hit,critical=critical,
                 damageRoot=None if result is None else result['id'])
    e['pendingShots'][shotid]=copy.deepcopy(child)
    if e['motes']==0:
        e.update(status='ended',endedAt=s['time'],cleanupComplete=True,endReason='seventh child terminal settled')
    return {'attack':{'d20':die,'INT':4,'PB':5,'schoolBonus':2,'total':die+11,'AC':target['AC'],
                       'hit':hit,'critical':critical,'normalDiceCount':4,'actualDiceCount':len(dice),'flatDamage':0},
            'damage':result,'childReceipt':copy.deepcopy(child),'parentBeforeOutcome':parent_before,
            'parentAfterOutcome':e['status'],'parentExhaustionDidNotCancelChild':parent_before=='exhausted-payload-pending',
            'RPOrCastHistoryChange':False,'additionalCounterWindow':False}

## Cover, sight, Hide and Search

Keep **visibility**, **known location**, and **line of effect** separate. Seeing through a barrier does not itself permit attacking through it. Best cover only: half +2 AC/DEX saves; three-quarters +5; total prevents direct targeting through that obstruction. Never add +2 and +5. For areas, evaluate line/cover from the area's origin to each target; total cover there excludes a creature unless the effect explicitly travels around/through the obstruction. The origin point itself must be legally targetable.

Within normal ranged range, no range penalty; beyond normal through long, disadvantage; beyond long, illegal. Ranged attacks also have disadvantage when within5ft of a non-Incapacitated hostile that can see the attacker, even if the attacker cannot see that hostile. All advantage/disadvantage follows the single cancellation rule.

NEW **Hide**: permitted only against observers unable to see you clearly or where a feature permits. Roll DEX Stealth once, record natural die and total. Against each observer's passive DC `10 + WIS Perception modifier including applicable proficiency`, use the Core four-degree task system. Meet DC succeeds before natural1/20 degree adjustment; Success/Critical Success establishes Hidden for that observer. No unsourced passive ±5 adjustment for advantage/disadvantage. Actual Search rolls use their normal modifiers.

Hidden means that observer cannot see you and does not know your location. Clear sight or learning your position ends Hidden for that observer. Moving between hiding places can retain Hidden only if no clear sight/revealing event occurs. A failed Hide cannot simply be rerolled unchanged; a materially new hiding position, concealment, distraction, sight-breaking event or express reroll feature is requ
core cover Original books and alternate procedures remain unchanged. Full conditions, equipment, hazards and recovery integration remain separate work.

Use with [class rules](CLASS_PLAYTEST_RULES.md), [spell rules](SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md) and the [complete coverage ledger](GAME_DEVELOPMENT_COVERAGE.md). The [source conference](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/CODEX_CORE_RESOLUTION_CONFERENCE.json), [V6 findings](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/CODEX_CORE_SOURCE_FOLLOWUP.md) and [GPT proposal](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_CORE_STATE_AND_INJURY_PROPOSAL.md) preserve the reasoning.

def box(a):
    x,y,z=a['position'];dx,dy,dz=a['dimensions'];return ([x-dx/2,y-dy/2,z],[x+dx/2,y+dy/2,z+dz])
def interior_overlaps(b1,b2):
    return all(max(b1[0][i],b2[0][i])<min(b1[1][i],b2[1][i]) for i in range(3))
def inside(pt,bx,strict=False):
    return all(bx[0][i]<pt[i]<bx[1][i] if strict else bx[0][i]<=pt[i]<=bx[1][i] for i in range(3))
def segment_hits_interior(a,b,bx):
    lo=0.;hi=1.
    for k in range(3):
        d=b[k]-a[k]
        if abs(d)<1e-12:
            if not bx[0][k]<a[k]<bx[1][k]:return False
        else:
            vals=sorted(((bx[0][k]-a[k])/d,(bx[1][k]-a[k])/d))
            lo=max(lo,vals[0]);hi=min(hi,vals[1])
    return lo<hi-1e-10 and hi>0 and lo<1
